newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Qingling Motors up after strong results.
newsitem.headline: Qingling Motors up after strong results.

text.p: Shares of Qingling Motors Co Ltd rose on Wednesday after the company reported strong growth in 1996 earnings, brokers said.
"Strong earnings growth fueled demand for the stock," said Patrick Chia, research director at China Everbright Research.
Qingling shares rose HK$0.205 or 4.71 percent to HK$4.455 after they hit a high of HK$4.500 in early trade. Volume was 1.76 million shares.
The company reported a 140 percent increase in 1996 profit to 426.29 million yuan, from 177.62 million yuan in the year earlier period, in line with the market consensus of about 144 percent rise.
"The good track record of the company and transparency of the management also gave investors confidence in buying," said Sean li, associate director at Amsteel Securities.

Qingling said success in sales of a new model of light-duty truck boosted earnings in 1996. It said sales of that new model accounted for 90 percent of the company's total sales in 1996, compared with 57 percent in 1995.
